# Psalm 85 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. Of-the-sons-of Korah. A-psalm. You-showed-favor O-YHWH to-your-land; you-restored the-fortunes-of Jacob.

**2** You-forgave the-iniquity-of your-people; you-covered all their-sin. Selah.

**3** You-withdrew all your-wrath; you-turned from-burning-of your-anger.

**4** Restore-us O-God-of our-salvation, and-annul your-indignation with-us.

**5** Will-forever you-be-angry with-us? Will-you-prolong your-anger to-generation and-generation?

**6** Will-not you return you-will-revive-us, and-your-people will-rejoice in-you?

**7** Show-us O-YHWH your-steadfast-love, and-your-salvation give to-us.

**8** I-will-hear what will-speak the-God YHWH, for he-will-speak peace to-his-people and-to-his-faithful-ones; and-let-them not return to-folly.

**9** Surely near to-those-fearing-him his-salvation, to-dwell glory in-our-land.

**10** Steadfast-love and-faithfulness have-met; righteousness and-peace have-kissed.

**11** Faithfulness from-the-earth will-sprout, and-righteousness from-heaven looks-down.

**12** Also YHWH will-give the-good, and-our-land will-give its-produce.

**13** Righteousness before-him will-walk, and-he-will-set on-the-way his-steps.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **85:10**: Chesed and emet 'have-met'; tsedeq and shalom 'have-kissed' — personified divine attributes in dramatic reunion.

- **85:11**: Emet from earth, tsedeqah from heaven — cosmic reconciliation; heaven and earth joined in divine blessing.

— EMET
